title: Compliance Pulse Synchronizer — Evidence Handoff Playbook & Cycle Calibration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: Create a repeatable, cross-functional playbook and lightweight orchestration pattern (the 'Pulse Synchronizer') to coordinate evidence handoffs for SOC2/ISO audits, SSO/SAML rollouts, and audit-log retention changes. The goal is to reduce manual evidence collection time by 60%, eliminate single-owner bottlenecks, and provide traceable handoff telemetry for external auditors. Workstreams: evidence manifest schema, owner roster automation, evidence ingestion connectors (S3/Drive/Confluence), acceptance QC, and cycle-aligned rollback/runbook procedures.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical evidence manifest (JSON schema) published and versioned in Confluence
Automated owner roster generation linked to Org directory (sync runs nightly) and visible in Console runbook panel
At least two evidence ingestion connectors (S3 -> Evidence Store, Confluence -> Evidence Store) implemented with tests
Playbook runbook includes: pre-audit checklist, escalations, fallback owners, and 2 run-through checklists; validated in dry-run with compliance team
Operational SLOs for evidence ingestion (99% within 15 minutes) and handoff notification latency defined and monitored on Dashboard
Post-run audit report can be generated with a single click (owner, timestamp, digest, retention policy)

notes: Trade-off: Start with deterministic owner mapping (SCIM groups) rather than full ownership discovery to hit velocity. Plan to expand to heuristic ownership later.
Decision: Use lightweight manifest (JSON Lines) instead of heavy DB schema to ensure portability across on-prem Dedicated customers.
Risk: Customers with air-gapped on-prem deployments will need an offline ingestion path; add separate ticket for offline import UX.
Design consideration: Console runbook panel should surface 'next evidence needed' with one-click reminders to owners and a copy-to-clipboard manifest fragment.
Operational note: We will expose a minimal webhook for external evidence producers to POST manifests; initial auth will be signed tokens managed by KMS keys. Security to review token lifecycle.
